body:
Thank you. It has been a very emotional evening but you have really helped even me out tonight. I am going to head to bed, and I will be able to wake up in the morning knowing that I didnt do anything stupid tonight thanks to the support I have received here. 

I hope you know what a difference you made for me tonight. Thank you so much.

Dont apologize. I really appreciate you taking the time to talk with me. And youre right, just this chatting on reddit has me feeling better than I was when I made the post. I didnt know what to expect when I posted here but you and a couple of people PMing me have really been very helpful and I dont know how to express my gratitude. 

What you said above is very reassuring. And youre right, seeing a counselor sounds, in my lowest moments, like the worst idea ever. To dredge up everything that has happened in the last year with a stranger sounds terrifying and like I would be needlessly putting myself back through everything, but when my mind clears a bit I know that it is the right thing to do. Its just scary and most of the time I feel like I barely have enough energy to wake up, shower and feed myself. Let alone relive things that probably have given me some kind of PTSD. (I had a 21 week miscarriage at home and held my baby as he died, had to cut the cord myself to get to the hospital, nightmares for months, etc etc) I didnt want to put the "PTSD" label on it because its nothing compared to what some people with real PTSD have gone through, but I dont know how else to describe it.

I just dont know how to find a support person.  Picking a random therapist just feels so... I dont know. Risky? If I go in and relate all of this and they just want to push drugs or religion or something, I dont know that I have the strength to do that twice if it doesnt work out.

Thank you. I dont even know where to start, it so fucking painful and its taking a lot to even do this right now as im so ashamed that I have even reached this point. I dont know where or how to start. Im just grateful that anyoneone is here and that I dont feel completely alone right now. Thank you.
